scope: Pixel-aligned translated color-filtered image subsets and CPU bitmap-space blur/drop-shadow command policy; full dependency removal remains incomplete.

results.focused_checks: macOS image units, Linux production image/filter-layer/bitmap-glyph units, and HTML canvas integration pass.

diagnostics: Initial reference dispatch tried the macOS-only Dawn entry point; the independent bitmap-space comparison now explicitly executes the original CPU command policy and makes no GPU parity claim.
Direct LibWeb image filter case 5 showed that painting into a layer first is not equivalent to FilterResult::MakeFromImage. That unimplemented image-filter source route declines before mutation.
Bitmap-space case 252 showed that unbounded shadow input must not be clipped to the unshifted blur request.

Linux case 347 showed that a premultiplied RGBA image into native BGRA needs the pipeline sprite. Legacy sprite eligibility now checks both source and destination native layouts. The retained regression has red 3 on Linux and 2 on macOS.
limits: Browser dispatch preserves eligible macOS Chromium/Dawn filtered draws. The CPU bitmap-space protocol does not validate Dawn GPU pixels.

Translated, pixel-aligned color-filtered subsets are enabled for the CPU browser path; general filtered source-image transforms, mixed filter lists and bitmap-space color-filter restores still decline.
No Skia-free full-browser link or run is established.
